Name: SE_ACTIVATION_RANGE_PARAM_ST
Description: Activation distance of map sounds placed with MSB Sound regions. The row ID is the region's Sound ID (without the sound type); a Sound ID with no row uses row 0 (retail -1: always active).

Fields.Name: Activation Range
Fields.Description: The sound plays only while the player is within this distance (m) of the Sound region; checked continuously. 0 or less: always active. Retail 25–3,510.
